slides.title: Last food distribution: June
slides.body: A woman displaced from Humera told the writer that her displacement centre in Mekelle last received food in June 2026.

slides.title: Hundreds of thousands still cannot go home
slides.body: People displaced from Western Tigray remain unable to return, the article says, while fighting since late September adds new needs.
